headline: Impeachment Day 16 Ends With Disputes Over Cash-Flow Exhibits and Receipts
seoTitle: Impeachment Day 16 Ends With Evidence Disputes | FMB News
seoDescription: Day 16 of the vice presidential impeachment trial ended with disputes over demonstrative cash-flow exhibits and acknowledgment receipts.
deck: Prosecution and defense disputed how visual aids and financial records should be treated as the Senate court completed another day of hearings.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Day 16 of the vice presidential impeachment trial concluded Monday after arguments over prosecution cash-flow visual aids and acknowledgment receipts tied to disputed confidential-fund transactions.

The FMB News evening brief reported that the defense objected to demonstrative exhibits, while the presiding officer treated visual aids as aids to comprehension rather than independent substantive evidence.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The day's proceedings followed testimony from personnel connected to disbursement records. Assertions by either side remain litigation positions unless adopted in a ruling or established by evidence accepted by the court.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The distinction between demonstrative material and substantive evidence affects how senator-judges may evaluate arguments about the movement and documentation of funds.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for further evidentiary rulings, witness scheduling and the court's treatment of disputed financial records.
